business_problem: To stay competitive in the evolving web3 landscape, the company sought to leverage generative AI to enhance its platform and improve internal productivity and customer experience. However, the company faced several challenges: manual setup of development environments on Amazon EC2 slowed deployment, its infrastructure wasn’t optimized for large AI models, and content moderation was needed to safeguard brand quality.
solution_summary: Crypto.com Builds AI Engine to Accelerate Video and Image Production by Using Generative AI on AWS Crypto.com is a crypto exchange and comprehensive trading platform serving 100 million users in 90 countries. The company faced challenges productionizing its infrastructure for AI-driven visual content generation prototypes, slowing deployment and limiting scalability. By building its visual content generation engine using a fully managed infrastructure for generative AI on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Crypto.com automated workflows, reduced large ML model loading times by 50 percent, and accelerated video and image production, cutting the time to launch new features by 50 percent.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and inference APIs that power the generative AI features.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference
solution_components.role: Handles long-running inference jobs outside synchronous request paths.

solution_components.name: Amazon ECR
solution_components.role: Stores and distributes container images for application workloads.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker notebooks
solution_components.role: Provides notebook-based experimentation for model development and tuning.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
solution_components.role: Provides clustered infrastructure for large-scale foundation model training.

solution_components.name: Amazon EC2 G5 Instances
solution_components.role: Provides accelerated GPU compute for AI inference or rendering workloads.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or managed inference for the customer workload.

solution_components.name: Hugging Face
solution_components.role: Provides access to pretrained models that the customer adapts for domain use cases.

data_flow: Source data enters the Crypto.com workflow through its application services, stored or indexed in Amazon ECR, processed with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker notebooks, Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and delivered through Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.
business_outcome: This speed improvement allows the development team to react to changes more efficiently, reducing new features launch time by approximately 50 percent.
